picks.thesis: The bear call spread offers a high credit of $0.29 for a 1‑point width (credit‑to‑width = 0.29) with a short call delta of +0.2893, placing it near the middle of the typical delta band. With 1 day to expiration and IV ≈ 18.7%, it captures premium quickly while keeping risk limited to the 1‑point spread.

The bull put spread provides a solid $0.24 credit for a 1‑point width (credit‑to‑width = 0.24) and a short put delta of –0.2967, also near the delta‑band sweet spot. One‑day DTE and IV ≈ 21.0% give a good premium capture with defined risk limited to the 1‑point spread.
